threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look in shock when the bus doesn’t stop on the red light at Kingsland Road. Everyone else just conducts business as usual.
Last night, a couple argued over their takeaway on the N37; she threw chips at him as the bus went past the snazzy new library. Hilarious.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw three kids selling handmade lemonade outside the U-Bahn entrance, laughing as they mimicked the ticket machines.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you spot a guy in a suit enthusiastically tango dancing with a stranger on the U-Bahn platform at 7 AM.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they dodge the BART rats like they’re part of the daily commute. Tourists just stare.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo sprinting to catch the Muni while juggling a giant teddy bear. Classic Tenderloin chaos, only in this city.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is all about the Gaudí, but the real magic is in the small, family-run bakeries where the local pastisseria has been the same for decades.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You'll notice them struggling with paella etiquette, often assuming it's a one-dish meal instead of a communal feast. It's the little things.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still flinch at the sound of the train screeching at 2 AM. Locals just smile and head to the late-night corner shop for snacks.
Caught a couple arguing about which local takeaway's chips are best. Turns out they both prefer batter over salt. Who knew?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Last summer, hearing a saxophonist on my balcony while the smell of kebabs wafted up from the street below. Classic Neukölln vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you grab a Köpi from a Späti, enjoy it on a bench, and watch a skate crew turn a city plaza into their stage—pure urban magic.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re local when they can name the exact taco truck that’s been parked at 24th for 15 years, no hesitation.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5 Fulton today behind a guy dressed as a giant taco, singing to himself. Only in the Tenderloin would that be a Tuesday morning.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think the 'Raval' is just a nightlife spot, but locals know it’s a vibrant mix of cultures, hidden artists, and unique cafes.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones staring at the metro map like it’s a crossword puzzle, missing stops because they didn’t realize it’s not as complicated as it looks.
